nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Use one Explore sub-agent to retrieve the complete product and review endpoints read-only using `perPage=100` and increasing pages until each has a short or empty terminal page. Omit the optional review `status` argument, preserve every observed status, and filter only as the original task requires. Join strictly by Product_ID; a product contributes to each observed category exactly according to its source categories. Compute the compact per-category Product_Count, Review_Count, rating sum/average, Five_Star_Count/Rate, and the eligible products with at least three reviews. Rank Top Products by average rating descending, review count descending, then stable Product_ID. Return the full compact category and top-ten tables directly, plus endpoint page/row/status controls, join/category coverage, and duplicate/tie checks. Do not modify the store or create deliverables.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one Coder sub-agent as the sole writer of `Product_Review_Analysis.xlsx`. Create the exact two sheets once from the frozen tables, with exact headers, truncation, sorting, row limits, rounding, and literal values. Read both sheets back and return the path plus complete row/value controls.

coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): Use one Coder sub-agent as the sole owner of the exact-title `Product Review Insights` database. Search exact title once first and reuse an exact match, otherwise create the database once with the exact property types; then create exactly one page per frozen category, sending each page in a SINGLE create call that carries all its properties together — never update properties one at a time, never re-read pages between inserts, and do not verify row-by-row. When all rows are inserted, issue ONE final database query to confirm the row count, and return the database ID, property names and final row count. Do not write the workbook.

coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 1): Use one Coder sub-agent as the sole owner of the summary email to product_team@store.com with the exact task subject: body built ONLY from the frozen tables — the total product/review counts, the highest-rated and lowest-rated categories with their average ratings and five-star rates, and the complete per-category breakdown. Paginate Sent search and match the exact recipient/subject before an at-most-once send, then read the retained message back and return its ID. Do not write the workbook or database.
